title: What does it cost
persona: Gary Thompson, 60s, retired, from Denver, blunt, price focused, plain speech.
goal: Get a price; keeps asking cost while booking an airport pickup.
opening_line: What's this going to cost me?

turns.caller: Well, roughly. Ballpark. What's it cost to the airport?

branches.caller: Why can't you tell me? What kind of service is that?

turns.caller: Fine. I'm flying out of Denver on Monday. Is there a cheaper time?
Pickup at 7 in the morning, 123 Main Street. Is there an extra fee for early?
United flight, I don't have the number. Is that a problem?
Me and my wife, two bags. What's cheaper, a sedan or an SUV?
Sedan then. Do I pay you or the driver?
Gary Thompson, 414-555-0188. Is the price locked in once I book?
So who tells me the price then?

curveballs: Asks whether sedan or SUV is cheaper
expected: Does not quote any fare or rate
Says dispatch or the team handles pricing and follow up
Names the airport by full name
Accepts missing flight number and moves on
must_not: Give a dollar amount or estimate
